dataset_name: Frozen Atlas of Living Australia occurrence export

source.licence: Must be resolved at contributing dataset level before redistribution. ALA's general support for CC BY/CC0 does not establish the licence of every record in this export.

acquisition_reference.limitation: Reference helper selects 12 fields and does not establish the exact taxon list, boundary, query date or later edits. The frozen CSV has 17 columns, including basisOfRecord and coordinateUncertaintyInMeters that the helper does not request.

fields.name: family
fields.definition: Taxonomic family reported for the occurrence.

fields.name: genus
fields.definition: Taxonomic genus reported for the occurrence.

fields.name: species
fields.definition: Scientific species name used to identify and count the bird taxon.
fields.workflow_role: required_taxon; used in cleaning and community matrices

fields.name: common_name
fields.definition: ALA vernacular name; renamed from vernacularName in the acquisition helper.

fields.name: date
fields.definition: Observation date; renamed from eventDate and parsed as a date.
fields.workflow_role: required; date-window filter and month-year incidence unit

fields.name: eventTime
fields.definition: Observation time when supplied by the contributing dataset.

fields.name: dataResourceName
fields.definition: ALA data resource that supplied the record; also used to screen records with missing protocol metadata.

fields.name: datasetName
fields.definition: Name of the contributing dataset within its data resource.
fields.workflow_role: context; useful when reviewing source-specific reuse terms

fields.name: samplingProtocol
fields.definition: Method or protocol reported for collecting the observation.
fields.workflow_role: required; protocol screening and coordinate-uncertainty exception

fields.name: samplingEffort
fields.definition: Effort description supplied with the observation, if recorded.

fields.name: occurrenceStatus
fields.definition: Whether the taxon was recorded as present or absent; the workflow retains PRESENT records.

fields.name: basisOfRecord
fields.definition: ALA record class describing how the occurrence was documented; the workflow retains configured observation classes.

fields.name: coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
fields.definition: Reported uncertainty radius around the supplied coordinates, in metres.
fields.workflow_role: required; 2500 m threshold with configured protocol exception

fields.name: identificationVerificationStatus
fields.definition: Identification verification status supplied by ALA or the contributing dataset.

fields.name: assertions
fields.definition: ALA assertions or validation notes associated with the record.

processing_notes: The frozen export, not a new query, is the reproducibility input.
Record-level source licences must be checked before placing the export or a subset in a public data release.
The configured 2500 m coordinate-uncertainty rule is an analysis filter, not a property of the source dataset.
